name: Chamael
source:
Chamael (カマエル, Kamaeru) is a high-ranking angel in the third part of Monster Girl Quest!.

She appears accompanying Granael, Runael, and Veteran Angel Soldiers in Sealed Sinner’s Prison, ambushing Luka and Alice. [spoiler]Chamael informs Black Alice, who intends to toy with Luka, that Seraph Eden accuses her of meddling with Ilias’ plans, forcing the 8th Monster Lord to withdraw. The angels then proceed to deal with Luka, however Alice’s interference with the prison inadvertently releases Heinrich’s soul, who swiftly cuts Chamael in half, much to her and the angels’ shock.  [/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Chamael]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
